name: Champagne Bridal Dupatta
description:
This sheer net dupatta features stunning champagne overlay embroidery. The thickness of the border makes it an ideal addition to a red or contrasting Muslim lehenga or wedding dress. Use it as one of your double dupatta for a bridal look that sets you apart on your special day.

Fabric and Patterns and Designs for Champagne Dupattas

The thick border makes this an ideal dupatta to wear over your hijab, to the back. First set your jewelry over your hijab, then pin the dupatta so that it frames the jewelry and your face. Lovely! It is best worn to the back, but it can be accordion-wrapped over one shoulder to add the perfect touch of elegance to your ensemble. For a more dramatic effect, consider pairing it with the dupatta that came with your bridal outfit to enhance your overall appearance and create a stunning bridal outfit.
